rows.grounds: accusative object of cūrṇayet; plant name
causative/optative verb governing the accusative objects

items.question: Which four substances must be powdered in equal measure for this preparation?
premises: koraṇṭa, pippala, root, and triphala are the listed ingredients
cūrṇayet directs that they be powdered
items.inference: The preparation calls for equal powdering of those four substances.
uncertainties: pippala may denote fruit or leaf
items.plain_english: Powder koraṇṭa, pippala, root, and triphala equally.
